Candidate spectral features

Source: R/features.R
fb_feature_set.Rd

Defines the per-date features whose temporal contrast across field borders is ranked by fb_rank_contrast(). The default set, used to develop and validate the method, holds the bands and the normalised differences of all band pairs, (a - b) / (a + b + 1e-4). With set = "svid", published spectral indices from the catalogue of the svid package (and, optionally, expressions generated by an svid grammar) that can be computed from the available bands are added.

Usage

fb_feature_set(bands, set = c("nd", "svid"), grammar = NULL)

Arguments

bands

Band names of the stack (Sentinel-2 names such as "B04").

set

"nd" (bands and normalised differences) or "svid".

grammar

Optional svid_grammar object whose expressions are added when set = "svid"; keep it small, because every expression is ranked.

Value

A data frame with columns name, expr (an R expression in the band names) and type ("band", "nd", "svid").

Examples

fs <- fb_feature_set(c("B02", "B03", "B04", "B08"))
fs
#>           name                             expr type
#> 1          B02                              B02 band
#> 2          B03                              B03 band
#> 3          B04                              B04 band
#> 4          B08                              B08 band
#> 5  ND(B02,B03) (B02 - B03) / (B02 + B03 + 1e-4)   nd
#> 6  ND(B02,B04) (B02 - B04) / (B02 + B04 + 1e-4)   nd
#> 7  ND(B02,B08) (B02 - B08) / (B02 + B08 + 1e-4)   nd
#> 8  ND(B03,B04) (B03 - B04) / (B03 + B04 + 1e-4)   nd
#> 9  ND(B03,B08) (B03 - B08) / (B03 + B08 + 1e-4)   nd
#> 10 ND(B04,B08) (B04 - B08) / (B04 + B08 + 1e-4)   nd
if (requireNamespace("svid", quietly = TRUE)) {
  sv <- fb_feature_set(fb_example_bands(), set = "svid")
  table(sv$type)
  head(sv[sv$type == "svid", ])
}
#>             name
#> 56 svid:AFRI1600
#> 57 svid:AFRI2100
#> 58    svid:ANDWI
#> 59      svid:ARI
#> 60     svid:ARI2
#> 61      svid:AVI
#>                                                                       expr type
#> 56                                   (B08 - 0.66 * B11)/(B08 + 0.66 * B11) svid
#> 57                                     (B08 - 0.5 * B12)/(B08 + 0.5 * B12) svid
#> 58 (B02 + B03 + B04 - B08 - B11 - B12)/(B02 + B03 + B04 + B08 + B11 + B12) svid
#> 59                                                       (1/B03) - (1/B05) svid
#> 60                                               B08 * ((1/B03) - (1/B05)) svid
#> 61                                   (B08 * (1 - B04) * (B08 - B04))^(1/3) svid
